thread:
Nina: Quick coordination thread  we have 5 open docs PRs that are blocking a product release. Need reviewer volunteers + preview checks. Short list: SDK example update, migration appendix, four broken links, and a tiny CLI example fix.

Raj: I can jump on the SDK example (PR #4401). Will run the preview and smoke-test the snippets.

Priya: I'll take the migration appendix (#4395) but heads-up I have a customer call at 2pm so may be slower.

Nina: Thanks. Marco, any chance you can do link cleanup (#4410,#4412)? They're mostly redirects and a few dead anchors.

Marco: Yes, will take both. I'll also add a small script to validate redirects locally.

Priya: Note on #4395  there are two deprecated flags and one call signature change. I plan to update examples and add a note in the "breaking-changes" section.

Nina: Process reminder: for anything that edits code samples or migration steps, require two reviewers + green preview. For purely textual/link fixes, one reviewer ok. We'll treat redirects as "textual" unless they touch example anchors.

Raj: Running the preview now for #4401. If preview fails, I'll run locally with:
```
make docs-preview
# or
pnpm docs:dev
```
I'll paste the URL in the PR comments.

infra-bot: PR #4401  preview: failed  logs: https://ci.example.com/4401/build-logs

Raj: Seeing an MDX parse error in sdk/snippets/ts.md  stray angle bracket in a fenced block. Pushing a tiny fix.

Marco: Redirects validated locally; noticed one cross-repo link that needs to change to absolute. Updated #4410 description with instructions.

docs-helpers: Checkpoint: PR #4395 has failing linkcheck; recommended action: short patch to anchors.

Nina: Priya, if migration appendix changes surface-area, please ask for a second reviewer (Raj or Marco). We need to avoid accidental API mismatches.

Priya: Will do. @Raj PTAL after I push changes.

Raj: Reviewed #4401 after the fix. Preview now green: https://preview.example.com/4401. Left one nit about wording in TS snippet.

Marco: Merged #4412 (dead anchor fix). For #4410 I left a note about updating the internal redirect list; won't block merge but flagged infra.

Nina: Decision: merge window today 16:00-17:00. If you plan to merge during that hour, post in #docs 15min prior. Also, if preview flakiness persists, add label "needs-preview" and assign to infra triage.

Priya: Pushed migration appendix updates and fixed the two flags. Marking #4395 as "needs-2-approvals" and requested @Raj.

Raj: Reviewing #4395 now. Two small code fence fixes and an expanded note for deprecation timeline. Will approve once CI preview passes.

infra-bot: PR #4395  preview: success  https://preview.example.com/4395

Raj: Approved.

Nina: Summary and owners: Raj -> SDK examples (#4401), Priya -> migration appendix (#4395), Marco -> link/redirect fixes (#4410/#4412). Two-reviewer rule for examples/migration; single reviewer ok for link text. If anyone hits preview flakiness ping infra. Thanks all.

Marco: Quick ask: can we rotate reviewer coverage next week? I'm getting a lot of small link fixes and want to spread load.

Nina: Yes, I'll draft a weekly rotation and post in #docs tomorrow.
